description: Set up baseline environment with uv and verify existing tests pass before making changes
steps: cd /projects/sandbox/job-search-agent/agent and run 'uv sync' to confirm uv can resolve the existing pyproject.toml and create a lockfile
Run 'uv run pytest -v --tb=short' to confirm existing tests pass
Run 'uv run mypy src/' to confirm type checking passes
Run 'uv run ruff check .' and 'uv run black --check .' to confirm linting/formatting passes
If any issues arise, note them for the next feature but do NOT fix pyproject.toml yet
acceptance_criteria: uv sync completes successfully in agent/ directory
All existing tests pass via uv run pytest
Type checking passes via uv run mypy src/
Linting passes via uv run ruff check .
Formatting check passes via uv run black --check .
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/job-search-agent/agent && uv sync && uv run pytest -v --tb=short && uv run mypy src/ && uv run ruff check . && uv run black --check .
findings: 1. uv sync without --extra dev does not install optional dev dependencies. Must use 'uv sync --extra dev' or 'uv sync --all-extras' to get pytest/mypy/ruff/black. 2. The root .python-version (3.13) is not automatically picked up in the agent/ subdirectory by uv. Need to pass --python 3.13 or create agent/.python-version. uv defaults to latest satisfying version (3.14). Used --python 3.13 to force correct version. 3. All 12 tests pass, mypy clean, ruff clean, black clean on Python 3.13.13.
